text.en: Dog owners praise trainer Joseph for his calm manner, clear explanations, and dedication to helping both pets and handlers succeed. Reviewers value his direct feedback and ability to tailor training techniques to each household, noting that he takes time to ensure owners feel confident applying routines consistently at home.

Clients report substantial progress in resolving behavioral challenges, including lead pulling, barrier reactivity, and household anxiety. Several reviewers mention that initial consultations and board-and-train courses produced immediate results, leaving their dogs substantially calmer and more responsive during daily neighbourhood walks.

Handlers emphasize the respectful and gentle approach used with excitable or fearful dogs, including rescue animals and stubborn puppies. Pet parents appreciate that training focuses on building trust without excessive stress, helping high-energy pets develop calm manners while remaining cheerful and enthusiastic.

q.en: Does Starr Dog Behavior offer in-home training?

a.en: Yes, the trainer provides one-on-one in-home lessons alongside personalized consultations to address household behavioral issues directly.

q.en: Are board and train programmes available?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention booking intensive board-and-train courses to resolve stubborn behaviors and reinforce basic manners.

q.en: Can the trainer assist with rescue dogs or fearful pets?

a.en: Reviewers report successful outcomes with rescue dogs and nervous puppies, particularly when addressing fears such as climbing stairs.

q.en: How do owners describe the training methods?

a.en: Clients describe the training as structured, calm, and focused on clear canine communication and consistent handler leadership.
